research_problem: LLM code generation frequently misuses library APIs, but prior studies used synthetic tasks and rule-based repair lacks semantic understanding
technical_approach: 6,000 unique APIs (Python/Java) from The Stack; IDE-style method infilling and parameter completion with StarCoder-7B, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B and Copilot; EM/BLEU/CodeBERTScore; closed+axial coding of EM failures (kappa 0.97) using an adapted misuse taxonomy adding Intent and Hallucination; Dr.Fix detect-reason-fix taxonomy-guided LLM repair
primary_contribution: Large-scale study of API misuse in LLM code completion and a taxonomy-guided LLM repair approach
dataset_benchmark: 3,000 APIs per language from 631 Python and 486 Java repositories; 36,000 generations; ~6.5-6.7K annotated misuses
evaluation_metrics: Exact match at masked element, BLEU, CodeBERTScore, precision/recall; repair BLEU/EM/refusal
baselines: Plain prompting, Dr.Fix without taxonomy, fine-tuned CodeBERT/CodeT5 APR (Zhang et al.)
key_findings: Qwen2.5-Coder best (Python method EM 85.4%; Java 61.2% vs Copilot 53.1%, StarCoder 44.3%); hallucination most common misuse (up to 43.3% of Java parameter misuses), intent misuse 23.6-30.4% of method errors; Dr.Fix improves BLEU by up to 38.4 and EM by up to 40 points, far above CodeBERT/CodeT5
author_limitations: Annotation subjectivity; single run; closed-coding subjectivity; uncertain domain coverage; Python/Java only; limited backbones and APR baselines; frequent APIs only, not rare/deprecated
analyst_limitations: EM failure against developer code conflated with misuse; inconsistent annotated-sample counts; Dr.Fix tested on 10% with known misuses and text-similarity metrics, not execution; older 2024 models; no web/REST API client code; manual Copilot use
reproducibility: Medium: replication package, planned GitHub release; closed models
suggested_extensions: LLM REST/OpenAPI client-code misuse with spec-as-oracle; execution-validated end-to-end repair benchmark; spec/IDL-constrained decoding; deprecated/rare/security API misuse; agentic coding tools
evidence_location: Setup p.4-6; RQ1 p.9; RQ2 p.10-11; Dr.Fix p.11-14; threats p.14-15
integrity: Partial column interleaving; distribution tables column-split; figures missing
